notes.title: [Breaking News] Game updates will be arrived at November 17th!
notes.content:
Dear NF2 Captains,
 
It's been a long time that we couldn't have a big update for better gaming but finally we are preparing a significantly big changing of the game, and it will be applied on the 17th of November.
 
We decided to change the current play style to follow the way of Navyfield1.
 
Navyfield2 will follow the way of playing style like Navyfield1, and the overall playing speed of ship, shell, etc will become slower.
 

Below is the details and people can check.
 
1. ship speed will be decreased by 30%.
 
2. Shell speed will be decreased by 40%.
 
3. Ship turning speed will be decreased by 20%.
 
4. Eyesight will be increased by 20%.
 
5. Manual control will have 30% more accuracy rate.
 
6. Zoom-Out rate will be increased by 30%.
 
7. Morale rate will be increased slightly.
 
8. After sunken, when people out of the room, the win or defeat will be decided by the calculation when people out of the room.
 
9. Default UI rate will be changed to 120%.
 
10. Shop Item price will be changed.
 
11. Login Event will be started.
 
12. Boosting Event will be started.
 
13. Level Up Event will be started.
 
14. German language will be added.
 

We will try to keep up the good update process and next update will bring the premium ship and Fleet Battle System soon.
 
Thank you for your playing and hope your anticipating for better playing circumstance of NF2.
 
 
-NF2 Team

notes.title: [12/31] New Years Greetings & 2016 Plans
notes.content:
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/25515563/Work/new%20year%202016.jpg[/img]
Dear NF2 Captains,

Over the past year Navy Field 2 has come into its own thanks to your amazing guidance and patronage. With the New Year arriving, we again want to let you know how thankful we are for all of your loyal support. Navy Field sails onward into 2016 with new goals and plans. Please read on for a briefing on what’s to come. 

[h1]1) Tier 12 BBs are on track to be introduced onto the server this January or February[/h1]

- Only BBs will be added initially
- Additional details including screenshots will be posted soon
- We are working to introduce other Tier 12 classes following the Tier 12 BBs

[h1]2) Comprehensive Balance Patch[/h1]

- This balance patch is scheduled to be completed in January
- The patch changes will be tweaked as needed in the weeks and months following their introduction

Patch Highlights:

[b]BBs[/b]
- 10% faster reload speed
- 10% faster gun turning speed
- Defensive power will be increased

[b]DDs[/b]- 5% increase in torpedo power

[b]CLs[/b]
- 10% reduction in speed

[b]Other ships (excluding BB and SS)[/b]
- 10% increase in credit gain

[b]Aircraft[/b]
- Aircraft duration time will be changed from 7 days to permanent 

[h1]3) Fleet Battle[/h1]
- We are currently on course to patch this system in March

[h1]4) Harbor Assault[/h1]
- This extensive project is expected to be patched this April or May

*We may still see some additional changes or features introduced throughout the year. We will update you with notifications as soon as new ETAs or progress reports are available. 

[b]On behalf of our entire team, we wish you all a safe and prosperous New Year![/b]

-NF2 Team

notes.title: [12/14] Regarding a recent Gold bug
notes.content:
Dear NF2 Captains,

This past evening our team fully investigated recent reports regarding a serious Gold bug exploit stemming from our most recent patch update. The bug should now be fixed.

We understand how difficult it could be to resist exploiting a bug that provides free Gold, and with this in mind, we hoped to only reset Gold (take back the exploited amount) and avoid taking further disciplinary actions.

Unfortunately, there were a number of accounts that abused the bug to the fullest extent possible. Taking back the exploited amount of Gold from these accounts would put them well into negative gold amounts. As such, a number of accounts have been locked. 

Still, we hope to offer as much lenience on this matter since we could not address the issue sooner. If your account has been locked out and you wish to regain access, please send an email to [h1]sde.nf2@gmail.com[/h1]with details regarding your account. We will try to assist each user on a case-by-case basis.

Thank you to all who took time to report the issue and avoided abusing the system,

-NF2 Team

notes.title: [10/01] Southern Seas Event Notices
notes.content:
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/25515563/DSC03205.jpg[/img]

Greetings Captains,


Now that the Southern Seas Event period has officially started, we hope all captains are making the most of the events. With that in mind, we will post clarifications and answers to a few of the questions being received about the event in this thread.


[b]1. Battles Played Count (revised):[/b] In order for players to be counted for participating in a battle, (1) they must be in battle for at [b]least 3 minutes[/b] and (2) they must make at least 1 attack point or down at least 1 aircraft.


[b]2.[/b] [b]Gold Pay Back: [/b]All Gold purchases made during the event period (October 1st - October 28th) will result in a 20% extra Gold being set on a user account. This does not apply retroactively or for any purchases made after the event period.


[b]3. Platoon Farming:[/b] We have received concerns over the possibility of users forming platoons for the sole purpose of increasing their event win tally. We certainly do not wish to dissuade platoon play, we may issue warnings if players are explicitly shown to be trying to find an unfair advantage against others.


[b]4. NF Crystals:[/b] For players unfamiliar with the NF Crystal, it is a pure glass trophy weighing in at over 730g. It contains a blue LED-lit base and showcases a featured NF2 vessel suspended in 3D within. NF Crystal winners will receive their crystal at random out of the available types. NF Crystals are not offered for individual sale at this time. 


The following are images of an NF1 Crystal Trophy (the NF2 Crystal Trophy may differ slightly in appearance).

Don't forget that the sailor skill reset has also gone into effect! Please reorganize your sailors carefully to make the most of this reset opportunity and please enjoy the rest of the Southern Seas Event!
 

Thank you for playing Navy Field 2,


-NF2 Team

notes.title: Patch Notes: 08/12/2015
notes.content:
Dear NF2 Captains,

All of the following updates are tentatively scheduled to be performed during this week's regularly scheduled maintenance period (barring any issues during final testing):

[h1][u][b]1. The Daily Mission System will be added.[/b][/u][/h1]

Our team has listened to your positive feedback regarding our event period daily missions as well as requests for additional rewards, resulting in the development of the Daily Mission System. This system will offer a number of varying challenges that can be completed for various rewards, all of which are offered directly in-game.

[img]http://s22.postimg.org/uqind9ny7/Mission_1.png[/img]

By clicking on the newly added "Mission" icon, players can bring up the Daily Mission panel in order to view the available daily missions and corresponding information.

 
[img]http://s22.postimg.org/5hxtjlj0h/Mission_2.png[/img]

Once the mission panel has loaded, captains will be presented with the 4 daily missions of the day along with the following additional functions and details:

1) [b]Submissions/Mission Overview[/b]. A brief description of the mission along with the reward (usually in the form of credits) is shown here. Players are eligible to receive rewards upon completing missions on each respective captain account.

2) [b]Primary Mission[/b]. This is the main mission which will always provide a Reward box upon completion. Reward boxes contain a random Gold Box offering anywhere from 20 gold to 40 gold. Unlike normal missions, only one primary mission can be completed per "account" per day.

3) [b]Remaining time[/b]. A countdown showing the remaining time available to complete all of the daily missions. Once the countdown reaches 0, the missions will be reset and any incomplete progress including unclaimed rewards will be forfeited.

4) [b]Receive button[/b]. Players should click the receive button once a mission has been completed in order to claim rewards. Please do not forfeit any rewards by forgetting to claim them with the receive button.

 
[img]http://s22.postimg.org/u9xfqu075/Mission_3.png[/img]

Once rewards are received, they will appear saved to your [b]Supply Depot[/b]. Please double check to make sure that you have sufficient space available in order to receive all of your rewards.

 
[img]http://s22.postimg.org/rekcjyw75/Mission_4.png[/img]

Double-click all rewards located in your [b]Supply Depot[/b] to receive them on your account.

 

[h1][u][b]2. Ship balance adjustments will be made[/b][/u][/h1]

 
[u]The DP of CV class ships will be increased between that of CA and CL classes:[/u]

[img]http://s23.postimg.org/tj4apeoaz/Capture1.jpg[/img]


[u]The accuracy of high-angle BB will be increased by 5% (41 degree or above):[/u]

[img]http://s23.postimg.org/s7wjgxsp7/Capture2.jpg[/img]
 

[u]The accuracy of New Mexico will be decreased by 15%:[/u]

 
 [img]http://s23.postimg.org/ka24fafez/Capture3.jpg[/img]


[u]BB speeds will be decreased by 1 knot (Normal Speed):[/u]

[img]http://s23.postimg.org/79qdiusuj/Capture4.jpg[/img]

[u]CL aircraft space will be reduced:[/u]

 [img]http://s23.postimg.org/5tev0ppxn/Capture5.jpg[/img]

Our team will be performing tests leading up to patch period in order to make certain that these updates are fully ready. We will provide updates if there are any unforeseen issues and may delay the patch if deemed necessary.

 

Thank you for your continued support,

 

NF2 Team

-NF2 Team

[h1][b]5. Occupation and Flag Ship Game Modes will be added.[/b][/h1]

[b]Occupation Mode[/b] consists of 3 battle objective situations:

Objective 1: Occupy the targeted neutral base.
Objective 2: Occupy the enemy’s base.
Objective 3: One team tasked with occupying the enemy base while the opposing team is set to defend their base.
 
If primary objectives are not met, the battle will also end if all enemy ships are sunk.
 
[b]Flag Ship Mode[/b] is similar to Navy Field’s Flag Ship Mode:
 
The primary objective is to sink the enemy’s flag ship (players can bring up the battle report panel with the ` key to quickly determine their target)
 
The battle will end immediately after a flag ship has been sunk or upon the loss of all members of a team.

notes.title: [05/11] Important Notice for Fleets
notes.content:
Dear NF2 Captains,

Our team has been taking serious note of the recent influx of sub-optimal game play condition reports. With those reports in mind, we've identified the number of dormant fleet registrations as a possible source of lag related issues. Currently, we have over 1600 registered fleets; many of which are dormant or with limited use.

In order to explore all potential avenues of lag, we will take steps to disband many of the currently dormant fleets by next week's maintenance period (Wednesday the 20th). [b]Our current plan is to remove all fleets that contain less than 5 members.[/b]

If you currently have a fleet that you wish to remain registered, please simply make sure that you have at least 5 captains joined by next week (single users can simply enlist extra captains from their own account which should make this very easy).

This notice is being provided just as a heads up. We are also looking into all other possible ways to continually improve conditions.

Thank you for your support and understanding,

NF2 Team

notes.title: [05/01 - 05/31] Share Your Moments Event
notes.content:
[img=http://s30.postimg.org/65o8vweap/share_your_moments_banner.png[/img]

It has now been 5 months since we embarked and we know that a number of captains are now veterans who have reached max levels. We’ve prepared this new event with these loyal users in mind as it would be a great method for them to share their techniques and tips, but also welcome all others to also participate by sharing unique Navy Field II experiences. 

Anything that you find to be entertaining or of interest to other players will be welcomed. If you can video cap your unique in-game moments, decisive enemy encounters, or tutorials, simply upload the file to YouTube and then send us the link! We’ll provide numerous prizes for a number of categories.


[h1][b]EVENT RULES[/b][/h1]

1) Simply, upload your Navy Field II game play video to Youtube. 
2) Send the link of your video to us through a website support ticket ([url=http://navyfield2.com/Support/ContactGm/Write.aspx?st=5]event section only[/url]).
3) Your Captain name should be visible at some point on your video.
4) Please also mention www.navyfield2.com in your video description.


[h1][b]EVENT PRIZES[/b][/h1]

[b]Awards for Most Thumbs Ups[/b]

1st place - 2,000 Gold
2nd place - 1,500 Gold
3rd place - 1,000 Gold


[b]Awards for Most Views[/b]

1st place - 2,000 Gold
2nd place - 1,500 Gold
3rd place - 1,000 Gold


[b]Random Luck Award[/b]

We will select up to 20 random event participants to receive 500 gold each. 

[h1][b]EVENT DATE[/b][/h1]

May 1st through May 31st

We will count the Thumbs Ups and views at the end of the event period. 

The winners will be announced by June 2nd. 


[h1]Game Capture Methods[/h1]
The following are some of the tools that could be used to capture your in-game moments. As with all third-party software, we cannot offer support on their use. Please only use what you feel comfortable with. 

1) NVidia GPU users can utilize their card’s ShadowPlay capability:
http://www.geforce.com/geforce-experience/shadowplay

2) AMD GPU users can use AMD DVR through the Gaming Evolved Client

3) Fraps – One of the most popular capture software
http://www.fraps.com/

4) Open Broadcaster Software – A new, free, open source capture program
https://obsproject.com/

We look forward to seeing what you come up with!

-NF2 Team

notes.title: [03/06 - 03/17] Ship Bounty Credit Event!
notes.content:
[img]http://s9.postimg.org/e2yro4xwf/Ship_Bounty_Redux.jpg[/img]

 

Dear NF2 Captains,


We've heard the requests and have decided to bring back an additional round of Ship Bounty Event to add to the current [url=http://navyfield2.com/Event/150305/Event01.aspx]Gold Rush and Daily Login events.[/url]


[b]The rules are very simple; all you have to do is sink specific ships for additional credit rewards. The rewards are as follow:[/b]


[h1]Sink 1 DD : 1000 credits     /    Sink 5 DDs : 1000 credits

Sink 1 CL :  1000 credits    /    Sink 5 CLs : 1000 credits

Sink 1 APA : 1000 credits    /    Sink 5 APAs : 2,000 credits

Sink 1 CA : 1000 credits     /    Sink 5 CAs : 3,000 credits

Sink 1 BB : 1000 credits     /    Sink 5 BBs : 4,000 credits

Sink 1 CV : 1000 credits     /    Sink 5 CVs : 4,000 credits

Sink 1 SS : 1000 credits     /     Sink 5 SSs : 4,000 credits[/h1]


[b]The sink count resets daily at 7:00 AM PST.[/b]

If a player meets the qualification of this event, then the credit pouch will be paid through the "reward" tab in-game.

The Navy Field 2 server will go offline Wednesday evening from 10PM - 12AM PST for routine maintenance. During this maintenance period, the following updates will be performed:

 

1) Founder’s Credit Bonus Event will be started. All players will receive 20% more credits after each battle until January 28th.

 

2) Players now can participate in platoon chat with the command: /p (when they are in a platoon)

 

3) Text change: On officer information slot, Hit will be changed to Accuracy

 

4) Fleet tag costs will be reduced to 5,000 credits.

The resulting fix may likely consist of a change to the way in which the Platoon system prioritizes balance. We are deeply sorry for the temporary loss of this feature, but feel that it is necessary in order to provide an immediate improvement to the matchmaking system. Our comprehensive matchmaking update is still scheduled for the near future.

 

7) Players will now be able to add/deduct points through scrolling of the mousewheel

 

Thank you for your support and understanding.

 

-NF2 Team

[img]http://s10.postimg.org/soqvv0hjt/happy_holidays2.jpg[/img]

Happy holidays and a Happy New Year to all of our fans. Your support has been tremendous and will continue to help as we sail into the New Year.

 

NF2 has just recently been updated with changes developed through your feedback. Please check the new updates for yourself while staying warm and enjoying some heated NF2 battles.

 

Due to the holidays, our next scheduled maintenance period is December 29<sup>th</sup> from 10PM – 1AM PST. Patch notes will be updated in the near future, but here are a few of the things we are working to provide:

 

[b]The price to change fleet tags will be reduced from 20,000 to 5,000[/b]

 

[b]The price of the first CVs will be reduced (players who already have purchased them will be refunded the difference)[/b]

 

[b]A first win bonus will be applied as either:[/b]

[b]2x rewards for every first, second, and third win of the day or[/b]

[b]2x rewards for every ship a player owns[/b]

 

[b]The required EXP and credit amounts will be reduced greatly for the first tier 4 ship.[/b]

 

[u]These updates are tentative and subject to change[/u]

 

Our team is also finalizing tweaks to the match-making system with regards to balance and speed. We are also speeding up the development of  other previously mentioned projects intended to offer a more entertaining and enjoyable gameplay experience. We will keep you updated on the progress as it is made.

 

Thank you for your support,

 

Team Navy Field 2

notes.title: Patch Notes: 12/22/14
notes.content:
[img]http://s29.postimg.org/g5g5i0esn/patchnotes.jpg[/img]

Due to the holiday season, the regularly scheduled server maintenance for the next two weeks will be moved from Wednesday evening to Monday night. So, please make note and plan your play accordingly as maintenance will be performed at these dates and times:

 

December 22nd 10 PM to December 23rd 1 AM (PST)

 

December 29th 10 PM to December 30th 1 AM (PST)

 

*Server maintenance may be finished quicker than scheduled, so please check our announcement section.

 

[b]These are the patch notes for this week's upcoming maintenance:[/b]

 

[u]1) Contribution system will be changed.[/u] - Contribution system determines the player's performance in battle and calculates the battle result and rewards after battle.

 

- The actions necessary to receive contribution points will be reduced.

          This should result in a fairer rewards system.

 

- It will be easy to achieve a higher contribution rank if each class performs in accordance to their roles. For example:

          DD: Anti-Submarine, occupation

          CL: Attack points against ships; AA; [b]occupation[/b]

          CA: Attack points against ships; AA; [b]occupation[/b]

          BB: Attack points against ships

          CV: Attack points against ships and aircraft; occupy the base by transport

          SS: Attack points against ships

          APA: Occupy

 

- This patch will allow each class to have a fair chance at achieving a higher contribution rank.

 

 

[u]2) Destroyer[/u]

 

- The following DDs' torpedo launcher will be changed:

          IJN DD Minekaze Type M: 3 -> 2

          IJN DD Mutsuki Type M: 2 -> 3

 

 

[u]3) Light Cruiser[/u]

 

- Ship turning speed of CL will be increased.

- Overheat time of CL will be increased.

- Overheat cooldown of CL will be decreased.

 

 

 

[u]4) Carrier Vessal[/u]

 

- The following ships' capacity will be increased:

          IJN CV Hosho: 312 -> 390

          IJN CV Ryujo: 546 -> 598

 

- The following ship's shell capacity will be decreased

          KM CV Prject AIII 320 -> 240

 

 

 

[u]4) Submarine[/u]

 

- The following submarines' speed will be increased

 

Tier 5 -> 20% up

Tier 6 -> 15% up

Tier 7 -> 10% up

 

 

 

[u]5) Bug Fixes[/u]

 

- Fleet tag folder guide text has been adjusted

          resister -> register

 

- Broken warning message when players tried to leave the platoon while the battle was searching has been fixed.

         Player levels, which remained the same as players leveled was up, is now displaying correctly.

 

 

[u]6) Merry Christmas and Happy New Year![/u]

 

- Snowing on the shipyard to celebrate the holiday season.

 

Please look forward to these updates this Monday night!

 

Thank you for your support,

 

-NF2 Team

notes.title: Patch Notes: Launch Preparations (12/08/14)
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/1407NiA.jpg[/img]

Thank you for taking time to participate in the NF2 beta. Our team has been carefully going through all of the feedback received throughout the beta period. We intend to do all we can to satisfy our users and provide an enjoyable gameplay experience unlike any other.

With the beta period coming to an end on December 9th, we would like to share some information regarding what to expect in the initial stand-alone launch client, to be made available [url=www.navyfield2.com]December 11th[/url], along with upcoming plans. Please read on for all the details and stay tuned to the Navy Field 2 website and [url=www.facebook.com/navyfieldii]Facebook[/url] for details on Steam support progress!

[b]The following updates or changes have been tested and confirmed:[/b]

[h1]1) Manual key settings[/h1]

Key bindings will be changed to be near identical to the manual key settings of NF1. Veteran users may still feel a difference in control, but should be able to get accustomed quickly after a few battles.

Hot Keys will be fixed so they can be altered without issue.

[h1]2) Language filter[/h1]

The language filter will be fixed so only exact cases are flagged. This should resolve a number of captain name errors and will allow users to chat freely.

[h1]3) Miscellaneous graphical bugs and typos will be adjusted.[/h1]

[b]The following updates or changes require further testing but are confirmed for launch:[/b]

[h1]1) Revised Matching System[/h1]

[UPDATE] Our team has experienced some minor errors while recently testing the revised matching system. On account of these errors, we can no longer promise to have the system ready by Thursday (launch day), but will do all we can to make the patch cutoff. If we cannot provide the improved system as intended by launch, then it will be patched as soon as possible following. Thank you for your understanding on this.


Our current matching system initially tries to match up 2 similar teams (12vs12 and 16vs16 for example). Players who don't fit in to the balance have to wait until another team becomes available. This causes wait times that are far too long.

This system will be changed so that players who don't make the cutoff for the initial teams will then be set to battle immediately against each other. This may result in suboptimal battles, such as 5 vs 6, but players who participate in these battles will receive 20% additional EXP as compensation for the conditions. This will vastly improve wait times for individuals as well as shorten Platoon queues.

[h1]2) Fame System [/h1]

Fleets will be ranked each season. The Fame System will replace the tentative “Contribution System” as a method to assist players in being scouted by fleets. Players will gain a fame calculation when they participate in battle and achieve good scores.

This system will be solely dependent on the player's individual record, and will then be added to the fleet score once the player becomes a fleet member. With this, fleet leaders will have an incentive to scout good players to help enhance their overall fleet ranking.

[h1]3) Officer Slot System will be changed.[/h1]

There will no longer be any Premium Sailor exclusive slots. Sailors purchased with credit will be able to be loaded on any available slot. Prior to this change, sailors purchased with credits would only be able to be loaded on the currently designated “Basic Slots”.

With this change, players have the choice to devote their effort on utilizing credit sailors without feeling any pressure to make use of Premium Sailors if they don’t want to.

[h1]4) Battleship (BB) Auto FCS[/h1]

The auto reload will be slightly reduced as we felt that it has performed a bit faster than expected during beta.

[b]The following updates are being worked on, and will be patched shortly after initial launch:[/b]

[h1]1) Additional game modes[/h1]

[i]Annihilation mode – A basic battle mode with additional options.[/i]
Current mode– The default mode offered in beta
Allied vs Axis
Nation battle (e.g US vs IJN; UK vs KM)

[i]Occupation mode[/i]
Occupy all islands
Occupy the target island (just like Harbor Assault mode in NF1)

[i]Protection mode[/i]
Protect your commander’s ship mode
Protect your commander’s ship while you reach the target point (one team for defense; one team for offense.

[h1]2) Missions[/h1]

We will offer daily, weekly, and monthly missions. Players who complete these missions will receive item or Gold rewards.

[h1]3) EXP system[/h1]

Players will receive EXP when they occupy enemy or neutral bases. Players will also receive higher EXP when downing enemy aircraft with AA guns. This will provide a better incentive and tactical purpose for utilizing smaller ships in battle.

[h1]In addition to the listed changes, please expect many revisions and improvements to our website over the coming weeks. [/h1]

The most important note is that you please bear with us as we work to improve NF2 with your help and support. We realize that some aspects of the game may seem a bit alienating to veteran users or confusing for new players. With your help, we will work to develop our current foundation into an enjoyable experience for everyone.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback!
